newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM 1996 preliminary net Dfl 700 mln.
newsitem.headline: DSM 1996 preliminary net Dfl 700 mln.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday net profit from ordinary operations in 1996 would amount to at least 700 million guilders.
"This indication is based on the information currently available," it said in a statement.
It said higher feed stock costs "which could not yet be compensated for by higher selling prices, had a greater-than-expected effect on the result for the fourth quarter of 1996."
Analysts had been forecasting net profit from normal operations of 738 to 800 million guilders compared with a year-earlier 1.073 billion guilders.
DSM is due to publish definitive figures for 1996 on February 25.
